      • getEddaApplications

        public CompletableFuture<EddaApplication[]> getEddaApplications​(String cardId,
                                                                String currency)
                                                         throws OpenApiException
        Get the eDDA authorization applications of a bank card in one currency. The card id must be all digits; any other value fails with an error before anything is sent.

        AP accounts only: US data-center accounts get a region error.

        Parameters:
        cardId - Bank card ID (BankCard.getId())
        currency - Currency, e.g. HKD or USD
        Returns:
        A Future representing the result of the operation
        Throws:
        OpenApiException - If an error occurs

      • getRewardRecords

        public CompletableFuture<RewardRecordsResponse> getRewardRecords​(GetRewardRecordsOptions opts)
                                                          throws OpenApiException
        Get reward records from the reward center (cash, gifts, coupons, task rewards).

        The route has no date filter: to find rewards in a time range, page through the records and filter on their times.

        AP accounts only: US data-center accounts get a region error.

        Parameters:
        opts - Query options; may be null
        Returns:
        A Future representing the result of the operation
        Throws:
        OpenApiException - If an error occurs

      • getCoupons

        public CompletableFuture<CouponsResponse> getCoupons​(GetCouponsOptions opts)
                                              throws OpenApiException
        Get coupons (reward cards). By default lists the coupons that have not expired. The pinned top / bottom lists are repeated on every page.

        AP accounts only: US data-center accounts get a region error.

        Parameters:
        opts - Query options; may be null
        Returns:
        A Future representing the result of the operation
        Throws:
        OpenApiException - If an error occurs

      • getCouponOrders

        public CompletableFuture<CouponOrder[]> getCouponOrders​(String cardId,
                                                        CouponOrderType orderType)
                                                 throws OpenApiException
        Get the orders a coupon was applied to. The gateway rate-limits this route tightly per member, so avoid calling it concurrently. The card id must be 32 hex characters; any other value fails with an error before anything is sent.

        AP accounts only: US data-center accounts get a region error.

        Parameters:
        cardId - Coupon ID (Coupon.getCardId(), 32 hex characters; not a bank card ID)
        orderType - Which orders to list
        Returns:
        A Future representing the result of the operation
        Throws:
        OpenApiException - If an error occurs

      • getDeposits

        public CompletableFuture<DepositsResponse> getDeposits​(GetDepositsOptions opts)
                                                throws OpenApiException
        Get one page of deposit records. The server's total follows the page size rather than the record count, so it is not returned; DepositsResponse.getHasMore() reports a full page instead. The page size is always sent: at most 20, default 20.

        AP accounts only: US data-center accounts get a region error.

        Parameters:
        opts - Query options; may be null
        Returns:
        A Future representing the result of the operation
        Throws:
        OpenApiException - If an error occurs

      • getWithdrawals

        public CompletableFuture<WithdrawalsResponse> getWithdrawals​(GetWithdrawalsOptions opts)
                                                      throws OpenApiException
        Get withdrawal records. WithdrawalsResponse.getHasMore() reports a full page of the size sent (default 20, at most 50).

        AP accounts only: US data-center accounts get a region error.

        Parameters:
        opts - Query options; may be null
        Returns:
        A Future representing the result of the operation
        Throws:
        OpenApiException - If an error occurs
